subject: Planting 16, 579
fact: The date is Planting 16, 579, when the group decides to return to Hommlett after a confession from a bandit.
source_quote: Date: Planting 16, 579

subject: Hommlett
fact: Hommlett is the destination the group returns to after a bandit’s confession, and it is the central hub of village politics and intrigue.
source_quote: the group decides to return to Hommlett

subject: The Tower
fact: The Tower is visible in the distance and becomes a focal point of the group’s investigation and the Prefect’s frustration.
source_quote: the heroes can see “The Tower” in the distance

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer insists on informing the Prefect of what has happened and later presents the stone as proof, only to be shocked by the Prefect’s reaction.
source_quote: Calmer insists, “We must go to the Prefect and inform him of what has happened!”

subject: Terjon
fact: Prefect Terjon examines the stone, dismisses it as a painted rock, refuses to keep it initially, then surprisingly changes his mind and keeps it.
source_quote: Terjon surprisingly says, “I would like to keep this worthless rock.”

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr challenges Terjon’s decision to keep the rock, causes Terjon to toss it to him, and later hands it to Burne and Rufus, triggering their realization of a conspiracy.
source_quote: Zephyr smiles sweetly, “If this rock is so worthless, why keep it?”

subject: Burne
fact: Burne examines the rock, dismisses it as insufficient, then becomes thoughtful after Zephyr’s account and connects it to missing blueprints and charcoal dust.
source_quote: Burne mutters, “This is it?”

subject: Rufus
fact: Rufus reveals he recently rechecked the blueprints for the keep and found traces of charcoal dust, suspecting a saboteur who worked with the bandits.
source_quote: Rufus whispers, “We may have a job for you. I was recently examining the blueprints for the keep and found them missing. My architect had no idea where they went. When I rechecked them later, they had returned, but there were traces of charcoal dust on them. I suspect that someone has copied our blueprints.”

subject: Ostler
fact: Ostler, the innkeeper, informs the group of the three-night minimum stay policy and the sale of abandoned goods, then offers a job to expose Furnok’s theft.
source_quote: I also noticed that you didn’t talk to the Druid. Does the Druid not like you? ... And as a matter of policy, any goods left behind are sold after three days.

subject: Jaroo
fact: Jaroo, the Druid, blesses the group with Beory’s blessing and a healing potion after learning they’ve spoken to all other village leaders.
source_quote: Jaroo is pleased and offers them the blessing of Beory and a healing potion.

subject: Kenter
fact: Elder Kenter reveals the council members, criticizes the lack of unified reporting, and demands the group report to him first before approaching others.
source_quote: The council members are Jaroo, Rufus, Burne, and Ostler, whom you have already met, as well as Captain Zeb Fletcher, father of Elmo and Mytch the Miller. ... Therefore, going forward, I expect you all to come here first.

subject: Elmo
fact: Elmo, son of Captain Zeb Fletcher, is a drunk but skilled ranger who volunteers to help the group find the monster in the Gnarley Forest.
source_quote: Elmo mutters, “I am your person!”

subject: Spugnoir
fact: Spugnoir offers to join the group as a fourth member, reveals knowledge of a lost wizard’s laboratory under Emiry Meadows, and demands first crack at arcane scrolls.
source_quote: I know the location of a lost wizard laboratory under Emiry Meadows. I am offering to split the treasures as long as I get the first crack at any arcane scrolls we find.

subject: Mickey
fact: Mickey, son of Virgil Tamen the Braumeister, reports seeing cloaked figures near the brewery at midnight and fears the temple is not dead.
source_quote: I've seen a couple of cloaked people lurking behind the brewery at around midnight. ... the rumors around the village is going that the temple isn't as dead as everybody thought. And so maybe, those are, uh, spies.

subject: Jira
fact: Jira, a teenage girl, and Marek, a boy, are caught spying and reveal they are forbidden lovers due to religious divisions between the old faith and St. Cuthbert.
source_quote: Jakub is a member of the old faith and won’t let Jira be with Marek, whose father is Tomlyn, the tailor and a member of the Church of St. Cuthbert.

subject: Temple of St. Cuthbert
fact: The Temple of St. Cuthbert is where Calmer explains the findings to Prefect Terjon, and where the stone is first presented and rejected.
source_quote: Once inside the temple of St. Cuthbert, Calmer excitedly explains to Prefect Terjon the proof that he and his companions have found.

subject: Inn of the Welcome Wench
fact: The Inn of the Welcome Wench is where Burne and Rufus are questioned, where Furnok is exposed, where Elmo is met, and where the group returns after multiple adventures.
source_quote: At the Inn, in the main hall, Burne and Refus are sitting at the table, drinking.

subject: Elder Kenter’s Residence
fact: The residence of Elder Kenter is a well-defended compound with five families, servants, and a central seating area where the council is revealed and the group is instructed to report to him first.
source_quote: They open the gate and step inside. Looking around, Zinia quickly discovers that the compound has five families: the village elder and his wife, the four sons and their wives. A gaggle of children of different ages is running around.

subject: Moathouse
fact: The Moathouse is the origin of the bandit activity, the source of the stone, and the site of the group’s next objective after multiple village missions.
source_quote: You must go deeper into the moathouse and find more evidence

subject: The Stone
fact: The stone is a small, painted rock found on a bandit’s body, initially dismissed as worthless, but later becomes the key that unlocks the conspiracy of missing blueprints and charcoal dust.
source_quote: Calmer has produced, rubs it between his fingers, weighs it, and finally says in disgust, “You bring me a painted rock.”

subject: Ivory Box
fact: The ivory box, found among coins in the collapsed tower of the Moathouse, is the size of a large book and contains unknown treasures.
source_quote: They find an ivory box about the size of a large book among the treasures.

subject: Loaded Dice
fact: The loaded dice are stolen from Furnok by Zinia after Zephyr’s distraction, proving Furnok’s fraud and satisfying Ostler’s job request.
source_quote: Zinia moves quickly and grabs the dice. As he picks them up, he realizes they are loaded—“The proof I needed!”

subject: Council of Hommlet
fact: The Council of Hommlet consists of Jaroo, Rufus, Burne, Ostler, and Captain Zeb Fletcher, who collectively govern the village but have failed to coordinate their responses to the bandit threat.
source_quote: The council members are Jaroo, Rufus, Burne, and Ostler, whom you have already met, as well as Captain Zeb Fletcher, father of Elmo and Mytch the Miller.

subject: Church of St. Cuthbert
fact: The Church of St. Cuthbert is represented by Tomlyn the tailor and his son Marek, and is in conflict with the Old Faith due to interfaith romance restrictions.
source_quote: Marek, whose father is Tomlyn, the tailor and a member of the Church of St. Cuthbert.

subject: Old Faith
fact: The Old Faith is represented by Jakub and his daughter Jira, and is in opposition to the Church of St. Cuthbert, creating social tension in the village.
source_quote: Jakub is a member of the old faith and won’t let Jira be with Marek

subject: Exposure of Furnok
fact: Furnok the Fabulous is exposed as a cheat after Zinia discovers loaded dice, leading to a confrontation where Elmo threatens to call the Captain.
source_quote: Zinia moves quickly and grabs the dice. As he picks them up, he realizes they are loaded—“The proof I needed!”

subject: Discovery of the Secret Passage
fact: A secret passage beneath the Inn of the Welcome Wench is rumored to lead to four lost chambers of a long-dead wizard, though no one has verified it.
source_quote: There is a secret passage below the inn that leads to an extensive set of four lost chambers of a long-dead wizard.

subject: Meeting Spugnoir
fact: Spugnoir joins the group as a fourth member after offering to reveal the location of a lost wizard’s laboratory under Emiry Meadows in exchange for first access to scrolls.
source_quote: I would like to go adventuring with you and complete your quartet. If you would have me?

subject: Confrontation with the Spies
fact: Zephyr captures two teenagers, Jira and Marek, spying near the brewery at midnight, who reveal their forbidden romance and religious divide.
source_quote: Zephyr quickly advances on them, his sword in his right hand, and puts the blade to the throat of the smaller of the two—the spy shrieks.

subject: Blessing of Beory
fact: Jaroo, the Druid, blesses the group with Beory’s blessing and a healing potion after they report having visited all other village leaders.
source_quote: Jaroo is pleased and offers them the blessing of Beory and a healing potion.

subject: Return to the Moathouse
fact: The group returns to the Moathouse with Spugnoir and Calmer, investigates the collapsed tower, finds an ivory box and coins, and prepares to enter the great hall.
source_quote: Inside the courtyard, Calmer asks, “What do we want to check out?” Zinia points to the tower that they ignored last time.

subject: Giant Wolf Spider
fact: A giant wolf spider attacks the group in the collapsed tower of the Moathouse but is swiftly defeated by the rogues and monk.
source_quote: As they reach for the coin, a giant wolf spider attempts to turn them into its next meal. But it is overmatched by the two rogues and the monk.

subject: Airgid the Silver Dragon
fact: Airgid, a silver dragon, is transported by the group to her home near the Lotrimil mountains, and departs with promises of reward from her mother.
source_quote: The dragon explains that its home is near the Lotrimil mountains. ... Airgid takes off and starts to fly west. As she leaves, she shouts, “Don’t worry, my mommy will reward you! I KNOW SHE WILL! THANK YOU!”

subject: Emiry Meadows
fact: Emiry Meadows is the location of a lost wizard’s laboratory, as revealed by Spugnoir, and is a potential future adventure site.
source_quote: I know the location of a lost wizard laboratory under Emiry Meadows.

subject: Gnarley Forest
fact: The Gnarley Forest is the rumored location of a monster, and Elmo volunteers to help the group find it.
source_quote: There is a monster in the Gnarley forest, and we will need someone to help us find it.

subject: Brewery
fact: The brewery is the site of midnight spying by Jira and Marek, and the source of Mickey’s fear that the temple is not dead.
source_quote: I've seen a couple of cloaked people lurking behind the brewery at around midnight.

subject: Ruined Boathouse
fact: The ruined boathouse is mentioned as a place Lysia, a farmer’s daughter, wishes to explore with competent companions.
source_quote: A farmer's daughter, Lysia, is itching to explore the ruined boathouse, but she needs some equipment and a few competent companions.

subject: Kron Hills
fact: The Kron Hills are the route west to the Lotrimil mountains, as described by Ostler, and are part of the dragon’s journey home.
source_quote: Ostler explains that that’s to the west through the Kron Hills.

subject: Greenway Valley
fact: The Greenway Valley is the fastest route to the dragon’s home, passing gnomish mining towns, as described by Ostler.
source_quote: The fastest way is to head south and turn north into the Greenway Valley. A reasonably well-traveled road passes small gnomish mining towns.

subject: Lotrimil Mountains
fact: The Lotrimil Mountains are the dragon Airgid’s home, and the destination of the group’s journey after completing village missions.
source_quote: The dragon explains that its home is near the Lotrimil mountains.

subject: Valsenora
fact: Valsenora, Elder Kenter’s wife, brings treats to the table after the group’s meeting, demonstrating hospitality and familial structure.
source_quote: They all nod and leave politely after sampling some of the treats that Kenter’s wife, Valsenora, brings to the table.

subject: Hawthorne
fact: Hawthorne, Elder Kenter’s second son, is a natural observer who tracked the group’s movements and reported them to his father.
source_quote: My second son, Hawthorne, saw you come from the moathouse. He followed you and saw you visited Jaroo, Terjon, Burne, and Refus.

source_quote: Marek, whose father is Tomlyn, the tailor and a member of the Church of St. Cuthbert.

subject: Jakub
fact: Jakub is a member of the Old Faith and father of Jira, who opposes her relationship with Marek due to religious differences.
source_quote: Jakub is a member of the old faith and won’t let Jira be with Marek

subject: Furnok the Fabulous
fact: Furnok the Fabulous is an inn patron exposed as a cheat using loaded dice, and is confronted by Ostler and Elmo.
source_quote: Ostler confronts Furnok, who rejects the accusations.

subject: Elmo
fact: Elmo is a drunk but skilled ranger and son of Captain Zeb Fletcher, who volunteers to help the group find the monster in the Gnarley Forest.
source_quote: Elmo mutters, “I am your person!”

subject: Mytch the Miller
fact: Mytch the Miller is the son of Captain Zeb Fletcher and a resident of Hommlet, mentioned as part of the council’s familial ties.
source_quote: The council members are Jaroo, Rufus, Burne, and Ostler, whom you have already met, as well as Captain Zeb Fletcher, father of Elmo and Mytch the Miller.

subject: Lysia
fact: Lysia is a farmer’s daughter who wishes to explore the ruined boathouse but lacks equipment and competent companions.
source_quote: A farmer's daughter, Lysia, is itching to explore the ruined boathouse, but she needs some equipment and a few competent companions.

subject: Spugnoir
fact: Spugnoir is a mysterious figure who knows of a lost wizard’s laboratory under Emiry Meadows and seeks to join the group as a fourth member.
source_quote: I would like to go adventuring with you and complete your quartet. If you would have me?

subject: Mickey
fact: Mickey is the son of Virgil Tamen the Braumeister, who reports seeing cloaked figures near the brewery and fears the temple is not dead.
source_quote: I've seen a couple of cloaked people lurking behind the brewery at around midnight. ... the rumors around the village is going that the temple isn't as dead as everybody thought.

subject: Jira
fact: Jira is a teenage girl and daughter of Jakub of the Old Faith, who is in love with Marek, son of a St. Cuthbert follower.
source_quote: The girl introduces herself as Jira, and the boy as Marek. They explain that Jakub is a member of the old faith and won’t let Jira be with Marek

subject: Marek
fact: Marek is a teenage boy and son of Tomlyn the tailor, a member of the Church of St. Cuthbert, who is forbidden from dating Jira.
source_quote: The girl introduces herself as Jira, and the boy as Marek. They explain that Jakub is a member of the old faith and won’t let Jira be with Marek

subject: Revelation of the Council
fact: Elder Kenter reveals the full council of Hommlet, exposing the lack of unified communication among its members and demanding the group report to him first.
source_quote: The council members are Jaroo, Rufus, Burne, and Ostler, whom you have already met, as well as Captain Zeb Fletcher, father of Elmo and Mytch the Miller. ... Therefore, going forward, I expect you all to come here first.

subject: Discovery of the Ivory Box
fact: The group discovers an ivory box in the collapsed tower of the Moathouse, suggesting deeper mysteries and potential magical artifacts.
source_quote: They find an ivory box about the size of a large book among the treasures.

subject: Joining of Spugnoir
fact: Spugnoir joins the group as a fourth member after revealing knowledge of a lost wizard’s laboratory under Emiry Meadows and demanding first access to scrolls.
source_quote: I would like to go adventuring with you and complete your quartet. If you would have me?

subject: Dragon’s Departure
fact: Airgid the Silver Dragon departs for the Lotrimil mountains, promising reward from her mother, marking the end of one mission and the return to Hommlet.
source_quote: Airgid takes off and starts to fly west. As she leaves, she shouts, “Don’t worry, my mommy will reward you! I KNOW SHE WILL! THANK YOU!”

subject: Return to the Moathouse
fact: The group returns to the Moathouse with Calmer and Spugnoir, investigates the collapsed tower, defeats a giant wolf spider, and finds an ivory box, preparing to enter the great hall.
source_quote: Inside the courtyard, Calmer asks, “What do we want to check out?” Zinia points to the tower that they ignored last time.

subject: Exposure of the Forbidden Romance
fact: Jira and Marek are exposed as forbidden lovers due to religious conflict, and plead with the group to help them reconcile with their parents.
source_quote: Jira pleads with Zinia to help them and talk to their parents — “You’re heroes, and they’ll listen!”

subject: Mickey’s Request
fact: Mickey, the Braumeister’s son, asks the group to investigate cloaked figures near the brewery, fearing the temple is not dead and spies are active.
source_quote: I've seen a couple of cloaked people lurking behind the brewery at around midnight. ... the rumors around the village is going that the temple isn't as dead as everybody thought.

subject: trophy room
fact: The trophy room contains a few mangy pelts, stuffed heads, and shattered antlers, some of which are the heads of dwarves, humans, and elves.
source_quote: Only a few mangy pelts, stuffed heads, and shattered antlers remain. Zinia, who enters the room, looks more carefully and realizes that some of the trophies are the heads of dwarves, humans, and elves

subject: domicile of the majordomo
fact: The domicile of the majordomo is stripped of anything valuable.
source_quote: The next door on the southern wall opens into the domicile of the majordomo of the castle. Zephyr sighs; it’s stripped of anything valuable

subject: westernmost hallway end
fact: The room at the westernmost end of the hallway is partially collapsed, and the remains of cots and plain wooden chests convince the rogue that this was once a barracks room for castle guards—undoubtedly the human sort.
source_quote: From there, Zephyr opens the westernmost door, where the hallway ends. Much like the other parts of the castle, this room is partially collapsed. The remains of cots and plain wooden chests convince the rogue that this was once a barracks room for castle guards—undoubtedly the human sort

subject: intact chest
fact: An intact chest is located at the south end of the room, and a giant lizard was using it as a lure.
source_quote: Zephyr notices an intact chest at the south end of the room. As he approaches it, he notices a giant lizard just in time. The lizard was using the chest as a lure

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia leads the group past the last door in the hallway and into a room with a stairway leading down.
source_quote: Sequoia leads the group past the last door in the hallway and into a room with a stairway leading down

subject: swarm of rats
fact: The room has a swarm of rats that are quickly killed.
source_quote: It also has a swarm of rats. Rats that are quickly killed

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer turns to the group, 'I suggest we finish exploring the ruins of the moathouse. Don’t want any nasty surprises to follow us.'
source_quote: Calmer turns to the group, "I suggest we finish exploring the ruins of the moathouse. Don’t want any nasty surprises to follow us."

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia agrees. They cross the wrecked great hall and head down the southern passageway, which is 70 feet long and has three doors. The hallway runs north-south.
source_quote: Sequoia agrees. They cross the wrecked great hall and head down the southern passageway, which is 70 feet long and has three doors. The hallway runs north-south

subject: old conference room chamber
fact: The first door the rogue opens reveals an old conference room chamber. He sniffs and shuts the door, 'Nothing to be found.'
source_quote: The first door the rogue opens reveals an old conference room chamber. He sniffs and shuts the door, "Nothing to be found."

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia mutters, 'And for door number two,' as he opens the next door on the western wall.
source_quote: Sequoia mutters, "And for door number two," as he opens the next door on the western wall

subject: bed chamber for a lowly official
fact: In the chamber behind the second door, there is what must have been a bed chamber for some lowly official.
source_quote: And in this chamber, he finds what must have been a bed chamber for some lowly official

subject: salon for meetings
fact: Across the hallway, another door is opened, revealing a room in shambles with missing things, but whatever remains still appears valuable. He enters carefully, and as he picks up the treasures, he realizes they are worthless. He looks around and mutters, 'A salon for meetings?'
source_quote: Across the hallway, he sees another door and excitedly opens it. He looks inside, and although the room is in shambles and things are missing, whatever remains still appears valuable. He enters carefully, and as he picks up the treasures, he realizes they are worthless. He looks around and mutters, "A salon for meetings?"

subject: large chamber at the end of the hallway
fact: The large chamber at the end of the hallway is empty of anything valuable, but has a giant poisonous snake that attempts to strike. It fails. Soon, like the other nuisance monsters the group has faced, it is dead.
source_quote: Leaving the salon and reentering the hallway, he walks into the large chamber at the end of the hallway. Much like other parts of the moathouse, this room is empty of anything valuable. Unlike other rooms, this room has a giant poisonous snake that attempts to strike. It fails. Soon, like the other nuisance monsters the group has faced, it is dead.
